description: This file defines classes, functions, and utilities related to handling operator schemas, argument normalization, and type hints in the PyTorch FX framework, including signature handling for TorchScript operators.

classes.name: ArgsKwargsPair
classes.description: A simple named tuple class for wrapping positional args and keyword args pairs.

methods.name: _nonzero_schemas()
methods.description: Generates and returns a list of signatures for the torch.nonzero function with different parameter configurations.

methods.name: Any _torchscript_type_to_python_type(ts_type: "torch._C.JitType")
methods.description: Converts a TorchScript type to an equivalent Python type using eval with global type mappings.

methods.name: inspect.Signature _torchscript_schema_to_signature_impl( ts_schema: torch._C.FunctionSchema, )
methods.description: Converts a TorchScript FunctionSchema to an inspect.Signature object, normalizing argument types and handling default values.

methods.name: inspect.Signature _torchscript_schema_to_signature( ts_schema: torch._C.FunctionSchema, )
methods.description: Caches and returns the signature for a given TorchScript FunctionSchema.

methods.name: check_for_mutable_operation( target: Callable, args: tuple["Argument", ...], kwargs: dict[str, "Argument"] )
methods.description: Checks if the target operation, when invoked with given args/kwargs, is mutable, raising an error if it mutates in-place.

methods.name: get_signature_for_torch_op(op: Callable, return_schemas: bool = False)
methods.description: Retrieves the list of Python signatures and TorchScript schemas for a specified torch operator.

methods.name: create_type_hint(x)
methods.description: Creates a type hint for a given argument, inferring from list or tuple if applicable.

methods.name: type_matches(signature_type: Any, argument_type: Any)
methods.description: Checks whether an argument type matches a signature type, supporting union, list, and basic type promotions.

methods.name: ArgsKwargsPair _normalize_function_or_error( target: Callable, args: tuple[Any, ...], kwargs: Optional[dict[str, Any]] = None, arg_types: Optional[tuple[Any]] = None, kwarg_types: Optional[dict[str, Any]] = None, normalize_to_only_use_kwargs: bool = False, )
methods.description: Wraps normalize_function, raising an error if normalization fails, ensuring a non-None return.

methods.name: Optional[ArgsKwargsPair] normalize_function( target: Callable, args: tuple[Any, ...], kwargs: Optional[dict[str, Any]] = None, arg_types: Optional[tuple[Any]] = None, kwarg_types: Optional[dict[str, Any]] = None, normalize_to_only_use_kwargs: bool = False, )
methods.description: Normalizes args/kwargs for a target function according to its signature, supporting overloads and type hints.

methods.name: Optional[ArgsKwargsPair] normalize_module( root: torch.nn.Module, target: str, args: tuple[Any], kwargs: Optional[dict[str, Any]] = None, normalize_to_only_use_kwargs: bool = False, )
methods.description: Normalizes args/kwargs for a given module's submodule's forward method to prepare for invocation.

methods.name: Optional[ArgsKwargsPair] _args_kwargs_to_normalized_args_kwargs( sig: inspect.Signature, args: tuple[Any, ...], kwargs: dict[str, Any], normalize_to_only_use_kwargs: bool, )
methods.description: Converts args/kwargs into normalized ArgsKwargsPair based on a function's signature, applying default values and handling argument placement.

ctags.name: _args_kwargs_to_normalized_args_kwargs
ctags.signature: ( sig: inspect.Signature, args: tuple[Any, ...], kwargs: dict[str, Any], normalize_to_only_use_kwargs: bool, )

ctags.name: _normalize_function_or_error
ctags.signature: ( target: Callable, args: tuple[Any, ...], kwargs: Optional[dict[str, Any]] = None, arg_types: Optional[tuple[Any]] = None, kwarg_types: Optional[dict[str, Any]] = None, normalize_to_only_use_kwargs: bool = False, )

ctags.name: check_for_mutable_operation
ctags.signature: ( target: Callable, args: tuple["Argument", ...], kwargs: dict[str, "Argument"] )

ctags.name: nonzero
ctags.pattern: /^    def nonzero(self, *, as_tuple: bool):  # type: ignore[no-redef]$/

ctags.name: normalize_function
ctags.signature: ( target: Callable, args: tuple[Any, ...], kwargs: Optional[dict[str, Any]] = None, arg_types: Optional[tuple[Any]] = None, kwarg_types: Optional[dict[str, Any]] = None, normalize_to_only_use_kwargs: bool = False, )

ctags.name: normalize_module
ctags.signature: ( root: torch.nn.Module, target: str, args: tuple[Any], kwargs: Optional[dict[str, Any]] = None, normalize_to_only_use_kwargs: bool = False, )
